build_tf_dataloader: build a TensorFlow dataset pipeline from JSON datasets with text, vision, region, and date augmentation
create_random_image_augmentation: create random image augmentation with skew, rotation, brightness, contrast, blur, noise, and sharpen transforms
generate_tf_dataset_sample: generate a TensorFlow dataset sample with masked text, region IDs, date distributions, and optional vision images
test_should_process_sample: test sample filtering logic that routes IDs ending in 3 to test, 4 to valid, and the rest to train
summarize_loader_tf: summarize the TensorFlow dataloader that loads Greek and Latin inscription datasets with deduplication, shuffling, padding, and batching
